titleEn: Boots On, Basket Ready, Off We Go!

pages.text: "Let us pick mushrooms!" Nils the little bear ran into the middle of the yard. His paws were empty and his feet bare. "Grandpa, hurry! Hurry!"
Grandpa Bruno asked from the forest cabin doorway, "Have you packed everything?" "Yes! All ready!" Nils bounced. Grandpa quietly looked down at his feet.
"What if we pick lots of mushrooms but have nothing to put them in?" Nils curved both paws in front of his chest. The space between them was empty. "Oh... that would be a problem."
"The forest path is covered in wet leaves today." Nils took one step into the yard. Cold mud splashed against his bare foot. "Brr, cold!" He hurried back to the doorway.
Grandpa lined up three things by the door: blue boots, a basket, and a water bottle. "These three will get us ready for our mushroom trip."
Nils pulled on his blue boots. Basket in his paw, water bottle into the basket! "Boots on, basket ready, off we go!"
The forest path really was wet. His boots squelched through the leaves, but his feet were not cold at all. "Boots on, basket ready, off we go!" Nils called like a song.
Grandpa put mushrooms in the basket one by one. It grew heavier. When thirsty, Nils took out the water bottle and drank. "I am so glad I packed these!"
The next morning, a woodpecker tapped, tap, tap, tap! Nils lined up three things by the door. "One, boots! Two, basket! Three, water bottle!" He was ready before Grandpa came out.

"Boots on, basket ready, off we go!" Nils raised his paws. Grandpa clasped his paw tightly. Line things up by the door and count them, and nothing gets left behind. "Today I will lead the way!" Nils said.
